effect.en: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

legend.en: After locating targets of opportunity, the Red Corsairs pursue them with shocking speed and relentless determination.

when.en: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army has been selected to Advance.

target.en: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Do not make an Advance roll for your unit. Instead, until the end of the phase add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

legend.en: The Red Corsairs excel in the furious violence of melee combat, butchering outmatched foes in a lethal flurry of steel.

when.en: Your Fight phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

legend.en: Huron and his spies are always watching and judging. Those that strive hardest to reach and destroy the Tyrant’s foes may earn a greater share of the plunder.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.

effect.en: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

legend.en: As the fighting continues, these warriors slip away, moving to outflank and surround the embattled foe.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that is within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

effect.en: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

legend.en: Centuries of combined combat experience enable these Renegade killers to eliminate any target, bringing down resilient foes by targeting weak points or reducing hordes of enemy infantry to bloody mist with rapid volleys.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that has just been selected to shoot or fight.

effect.en: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

legend.en: Hatred is a powerful motivator. Those who cross Renegade Space Marines rarely live long enough to regret their actions.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY (excluding DAMNED units) or HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

legend.en: Freed from the Emperor’s yoke, these warriors are motivated only by bitter hatred, channelling their ire into every brutal strike: even their final one.

when.en: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

legend.en: Renegades do not relinquish their prizes easily.

when.en: Your Movement phase

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

effect.en: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

legend.en: Without traditional methods of resupply and rearmament, Renegades must plunder or barter for their ammunition. Whether seized from the holds of captive vessels or acquired from daemonic arms dealers or xenos black marketeers, these munitions are horrifically effective.

when.en: Your Shooting phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit in your army that has just been selected to shoot.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, improve the Armour Penetration of that attack by 1.

legend.en: Reacting to incoming fire, traitorous infantry adjust their battle plan without breaking stride, moving to take cover or closing in upon their assailants with vengeance in mind.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) from your army that was hit by one or more of those attacks.

effect.en: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

legend.en: These warriors have not quite escaped the grip of the Warp, remaining slightly incorporeal in a way that causes enemy fire to pass harmlessly through them.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

effect.en: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

restrictions.en: You cannot target the same unit with the Empyric Dislocation and Armour of Corruption Stratagems in the same phase.

legend.en: Drawn to the largest and toughest warriors by their inherent sense of might and superiority, overspilling warp energies make their conceit a resilient reality.

when.en: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

effect.en: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

restrictions.en: You cannot target the same unit with the Armour of Corruption and Empyric Dislocation Stratagems in the same phase.

legend.en: Momentary flares of empyric energy wreathe this unit, causing them to stutter through time and space more swiftly.

when.en: Your Movement phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army.

effect.en: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

legend.en: Immaterial energies still cling to these warriors like tattered shrouds, leaving sites of significance tainted by their touch and haunted by insubstantial spectres.

when.en: Your Movement phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES TERMINATOR, OBLITERATORS or MUTILATORS unit from your army, within range of an objective marker you control.

effect.en: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

legend.en: These warriors have drilled relentlessly in the art of laying down murderous fire against dug-in foes the moment they teleport into battle.

when.en: Your Shooting phase.

target.en: Up to two HERETIC ASTARTES units from your army that were set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and have not been selected to shoot this phase.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

legend.en: The warp rift through which these warriors reach the battlefield has been directed toward chosen prey by a vengeful daemonic entity.

when.en: Your Charge phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not declared a charge this phase.

effect.en: Your unit has +2 to charge rolls.

legend.en: The blessings of Vashtorr flow through these warriors’ weapons, infusing them with power and mutating them into still-deadlier forms.

when.en: Any phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, if your unit is selected to make a Dark Pact, you can select both abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain.

legend.en: Channelling the infernal flames of the soul forges, this unit tears through its victims with blows and blasts that melt the toughest armour.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

target.en: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

legend.en: Offering up so great a sacrificial victim will surely win favour with the Arkifane, or go some way toward settling the looming debts already incurred to him.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

target.en: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

legend.en: Metal and muscle, wire and sinew flow together, reknitting battle damage with sparking clots of repulsive mutant growth.

when.en: Your Command phase.

target.en: One HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army (excluding DAMNED units).

effect.en: One model in your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, one model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

legend.en: Warp-tainted motive force and empyric plasma flows through engine and living entity alike, driving them on even as it scours them from within.

when.en: Your Movement phase, just after a HERETIC ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.

target.en: That HERETIC ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the SOUL FORGE keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.

legend.en: Responding swiftly to incoming fire, the bound entity within this daemon engine raises arcane wards to soak up the foe’s fury.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

target.en: One SOUL FORGE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

effect.en: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

legend.en: With the unbound energies of the Warp surging through them, this infernal champion heals of their hurts as quickly as the enemy can inflict them.

when.en: Your Command phase.

target.en: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER/DAEMON unit (excluding KHORNE units).

effect.en: Your unit heals D3+1 wounds.

legend.en: Chanting words of forbidden power, this heretic witch triggers a ghastly explosion of hypermutation within the bodies of foes, rapidly transforming them into heaving mounds of gibbering meat.

when.en: Start of your Shooting phase.

target.en: One friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

effect.en: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. Roll one D6: On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. On a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On a 5-6, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are inflicted by a psychic attack.

legend.en: Secondary cantrips blossom out like poisoned flowers from the heart of this sorcerous manifestation, raining mutating flame upon the foe in roiling clouds.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit is selected to shoot.

target.en: That HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER unit.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

legend.en: As the murderous rain of projectiles redoubles and the fires of ruin burn higher, so the favour of the Dark Gods falls upon the architects of this devastation.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit is selected to shoot.

target.en: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

effect.en: When your unit uses the Dark Pacts ability, your unit’s ranged attacks have: [LETHAL HITS]. [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

legend.en: Even as the foe attempts to escape the rain of ruination, or to close with the foes so cruelly winnowing their ranks, so these Havocs move to establish new sight lines and draw their victims into an inescapable crossfire.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HAVOCS unit.

target.en: That HAVOCS unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

legend.en: Gripped by a maniacal need to annihilate their hated enemies, these killers will not easily succumb to the clutches of death.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

target.en: That HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: With a last-second blast of speed from their jump packs, the Chaos Space Marines slam into their enemies blades-first.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

target.en: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

legend.en: Surging in and out of the enemy lines on wings of dark fire, these predatory killers wreak bloody havoc.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

target.en: That HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY unit.

effect.en: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

legend.en: So hideous and otherworldly have many Warp Talons been rendered by the energies of the Warp, that merely to look upon their approach is enough to scare the enemy out of their minds.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WARP TALONS unit ends a move.

target.en: That WARP TALONS unit.

effect.en: Select one visible enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
